skillset.skill: 13s CT - 3000% Water DMG (MAG). Increase own Arts by 30 and Leader unit's Arts by 30.
skillset.arts: Increase allies' Arts by 10. For 20s, allies gain a DMG barrier that negates [4000 DMG x # of times own Arts has been used] (MAX: 20000).

skillset.superarts: 150000% Water DMG (MAG). 100% chance to inflict Blind for 30s. For 30s, increase allies' stats by 80%.

passive.ability2: When "Miasma" Area Effect is active, increase Arts Over Time Effects by 50%.
